title: Genome annotation with Braker3
questions: How to annotate an eukaryotic genome with Braker3?
How to evaluate and visualize annotated genomic features?
key_points: Braker3 allows to perform structural annotation of an eukaryotic genome
BUSCO and OMArk allow to inspect the quality of an annotation

workflows.title: Genome annotation with Braker3
